description: This file defines the RuleChainService class, an Angular service responsible for managing rule chains, rule nodes, and related resources in the Thingsboard platform. It includes methods for CRUD operations on rule chains, retrieving components, resolving UI resources, and managing rule chains associated with edges.

classes.name: RuleChainService
classes.description: An Angular service for managing rule chains, rule nodes, and related resources in the Thingsboard platform.

methods.name: getRuleChains
methods.description: Retrieves a paginated list of rule chains filtered by type.

methods.name: getRuleChainsByIds
methods.description: Fetches multiple rule chains by their IDs.

methods.name: getRuleChain
methods.description: Retrieves a specific rule chain by its ID.

methods.name: getRuleChainOutputLabels
methods.description: Gets output labels for a specific rule chain.

methods.name: createDefaultRuleChain
methods.description: Creates a default rule chain with a given name.

methods.name: saveRuleChain
methods.description: Saves or updates a rule chain.

methods.name: deleteRuleChain
methods.description: Deletes a rule chain by ID.

methods.name: setRootRuleChain
methods.description: Sets a rule chain as the root rule chain.

methods.name: getRuleChainMetadata
methods.description: Retrieves metadata for a rule chain.

methods.name: saveRuleChainMetadata
methods.description: Saves or updates rule chain metadata.

methods.name: getRuleNodeComponents
methods.description: Retrieves rule node components, with caching and resource resolution.

methods.name: getRuleNodeConfigComponent
methods.description: Gets the configuration component type for a given directive.

methods.name: getRuleNodeComponentByClazz
methods.description: Finds a rule node component by its class name.

methods.name: getRuleNodeSupportedLinks
methods.description: Returns supported link labels for a rule node component.

methods.name: ruleNodeAllowCustomLinks
methods.description: Checks if a rule node supports custom links.

methods.name: ruleNodeSourceRuleChainId
methods.description: Gets the source rule chain ID for a rule node.

methods.name: getLatestRuleNodeDebugInput
methods.description: Fetches the latest debug input for a rule node.

methods.name: testScript
methods.description: Tests a rule chain script with given input parameters.

methods.name: registerSystemRuleNodeConfigModule
methods.description: Registers a module containing rule node configuration components.

methods.name: loadRuleNodeComponents
methods.description: Loads rule node components from the descriptor service.

methods.name: resolveRuleNodeComponentsUiResources
methods.description: Resolves UI resources for multiple rule node components.

methods.name: resolveRuleNodeComponentUiResources
methods.description: Resolves UI resources for a single rule node component.

methods.name: getEdgeRuleChains
methods.description: Retrieves rule chains associated with an edge.

methods.name: assignRuleChainToEdge
methods.description: Assigns a rule chain to an edge.

methods.name: unassignRuleChainFromEdge
methods.description: Removes a rule chain assignment from an edge.

methods.name: setEdgeTemplateRootRuleChain
methods.description: Sets a rule chain as the edge template root.

methods.name: setAutoAssignToEdgeRuleChain
methods.description: Enables auto-assignment of a rule chain to an edge.

methods.name: unsetAutoAssignToEdgeRuleChain
methods.description: Disables auto-assignment of a rule chain to an edge.

methods.name: getAutoAssignToEdgeRuleChains
methods.description: Retrieves rule chains set for auto-assignment to edges.

methods.name: setEdgeRootRuleChain
methods.description: Sets a rule chain as the root for an edge.
